acceptanceCriteria: The dogfood loop links OCM obligations so a sealed change reports requirement coverage other than unassessed, or the spec records why it cannot.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). PR #82 (V1-0025): every sealed wave-1 change reports 0 of N obligations linked; the console chain therefore renders every requirement edge as a gap on real history.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #136 (merge 4cde4fca7). Criterion 1: dogfood-change now runs corvint ocm link on each pass for every row of an optional author plan DOGFOOD_OCM_LINKS, recording ocmLinkPlan and ocm-link-NNN steps (DCW-V0-018, docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md:110-118; script/dogfood-change.sh:435; docs/DOGFOOD.md step 7, :26, :69). A replay of sealed change 75039ff (LAC-V0-032) with a one-row plan produced ocm-link-001 and 1 of 32 obligations linked (docs/BUILD-LOG.md:387-410); script/dogfood-change_test.sh passes at 6d4873a. Caveats: linking is opt-in, so a change without a plan still reports every requirement unassessed, as #131 and #133 did. A link on a change delivered end to end through the loop is NOT_OBSERVED, and no CEM sealed on main records linked coverage yet. Owner-only: DCW-V0-018 is a new MUST in an accepted spec; the ocmLinkPlan report field; the receipt repin (V1-0216). Known limit: rows for an intent whose map failed to prepare get no step. Sealed at .corvint/changes/643e9db886904982c14f70430d80795075f2809f.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, dogfood-change.sh, daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md, BUILD-LOG.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: dogfood: the loop never runs `ocm link`, so requirement coverage stays unassessed
